objective: minimize pinned Olympus hse_gap; no objective change
license_scope: Olympus repository MIT license; local lookup analysis. Independent original external repository terms and reduction lineage remain unverified; no redistribution or new DFT reproduction claim
initial_sampling: uniform without replacement among 192 config-ordered candidates
model_policy: one checkpoint per seed, fixed across all four methods; no retraining or hyperparameter selection

sa.schedule: neal default geometric beta range, recorded library version

adaptive.update: raw feasible rate after each 250-read batch; same fixed FM; not BBO iteration updates

qaoa.objective_for_angle_search: minimum expected surrogate plus method penalty; no true values
qaoa.cost_normalization: divide base QUBO and offset by base Ising coefficient scale S; add alpha as normalized penalty; internal lambda=S*alpha
qaoa.xy: product-W injection; ordered Ring edge RXX(beta)RYY(beta); lambda=0

scale: S=max(max_i abs(h_i),max_i<j abs(J_ij)) from base FM QUBO; if S=0 use divisor 1 and record zero scale
proposal_rule: pool exactly 1000 raw samples; reject invalid, training duplicates, and within-pool duplicates; select up to five unseen valid candidates ranked by FM QUBO prediction with tuple tie-break; no resampling to fill deficit

bb_budget_per_method.shortfall: retain and report unused budget; do not fabricate or remove failure

diagnostic_reference: full-table values used only for independent holdout quality and reference scoring; never passed into FM training or angle search except 20 training values
metrics: surrogate gap against full feasible FM optimum
accepted best true gap and normalized regret using audited full-table min/max
initial/model hashes and all raw samples
conditional unseen expected true gap (audit only)
exact QAOA unseen true-top5% mass; cutoff tenth smallest among full 192 table
statistics: five paired seeds; median and IQR; paired differences and two-sided Wilcoxon with Bonferroni over 6 pairs; report insufficient small-sample power
uniform_reference: exact uniform distribution over the 172 held-out candidates, as diagnostic baseline only
resume_policy: completed seed records reused only if protocol, initial data and code hashes match; failed runs retained; protocol changes require new version
